owner_statement: the three square bumps on the base are too high ; revise ; the side without the bumps sits flush, the side with the bumps has a several millimeter gap
specific_failure_mode: R8 front base pads (pad_x=[[10,16],[27,33],[46,52]], front_pad_y=[0.8,5.8], z=5.8 mm) collided with underside Radxa ZERO 3E v1.2 components omitted from Radxa's 3D STEP file (U12 16-pin SOIC IC at x=29.8..33.1, micro-HDMI & USB-C through-hole shield legs, ED9-12, C151), lifting the front side of the board by ~2-3 mm while the bare-edge rear side (back_pad_y=[29.0,30.2], clear of GPIO pads at y<=28.75) sat flush.
replacement_requirements: Replace R8's three 6 x 5 mm interior front base pads (y=0.8..5.8) with narrow bare-edge pads verified 0-hit against official radxa_zero_3e_v1200_bottom.dxf across full XY board float, leaving 4.20 mm clear floor height under U12 and all front THT connector legs.
Encode real ZERO 3E v1.2 bottom-side and top-side DXF component envelopes into reference_envelopes.scad and enforce 9-pose XY board-float clearance checks against base, bare-lid, and poe-lid.
Also clear bare-lid top retention ribs of all top-side SMD footprints in radxa_zero_3e_v1200_top.dxf across full XY board float.
physical_test_limit: Owner physical fit observation supersedes R8 digital checks. Exact caliper measurements, insert pull-out, cable seating, and powered thermal results remain NOT RUN on R8.
